content.short: Super is an integrated fiat & crypto billing platform for web3 merchants.
content.description: Super unifies fiat and crypto payments for web3 merchants by providing a single, streamlined checkout that eliminates fragmented payment flows. Merchants can accept payments through a mix of no-code tools and APIs, enabling quick and flexible integration without heavy development. Its capabilities include automated quoting and AI-powered transaction matching, with a broader set of features designed to simplify operations, lessen manual tasks, and improve the overall checkout experience across diverse payment scenarios.
content.meta: Super is an integrated fiat & crypto billing platform designed to help web3 merchants. Discover Super and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
